content.short: 3air is a Blockchain-based Telecom platform focused on bringing broadband internet, digital TV, and telephony to millions of underserved Africans.
content.description: We are going to provide broadband connectivity to the masses focusing on Africa specifically building a blockchain-based platform for easy access to services, identity management, payments, and credit line. We are building and focusing on expanding and testing new concepts in bandwidth tokenization, IoT for telecoms, and roaming.
